headline: Polymarket Odds of U.S. President Trump Impeachment Jump to 65%
summary: Traders on Polymarket raised the odds of a Trump impeachment by June 2027 to 65 percent, up 19 points in a day following the Democratic House victory on November 3.
why: Prediction markets aggregate political risk sentiment, which can influence regulatory expectations and broad financial market volatility.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Prediction market odds for a presidential impeachment rose following congressional election outcomes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A shift in congressional control increased perceived political risks, causing a sharp repricing in prediction market contracts.
